scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run scrapers:typecheck
scripts.types:cloudflare: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface CloudflareEnv && wrangler types crawler-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.crawler.jsonc --env-interface CrawlerEnv
scripts.db:migrate:production: node scripts/production-guard.mjs wrangler.production.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply coffeedb-v2 --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/production-guard.mjs --site-url wrangler.production.jsonc && npm run build:production && node scripts/production-guard.mjs --site-url dist/server/wrangler.json && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --var NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL:$NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL --domain kahve.hellobasalt.dev && tsx scripts/warm-cache.mts $NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
scripts.ci:build: node scripts/production-guard.mjs --site-url wrangler.production.jsonc && npm run build:production && node scripts/production-guard.mjs --site-url dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.ci:deploy: node scripts/production-guard.mjs --site-url dist/server/wrangler.json && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --var NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL:$NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL --domain kahve.hellobasalt.dev && (tsx scripts/warm-cache.mts $NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || echo 'Warm-up failed after a good deploy: the first visitors compute the derived results.')
scripts.deploy:crawler:production: node scripts/production-guard.mjs wrangler.crawler.production.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.crawler.production.jsonc
